name: gstack-installer
description: Bootstraps gstack (garrytan/gstack) into Claude Code. gstack ships as a 70+ skill bundle installed to ~/.claude/skills/gstack via its own `./setup` build (it compiles the `browse` browser binary and wires ~60 bin tools), so it cannot be loaded as a normal plugin. This plugin adds one `/install-gstack` skill that runs the upstream clone + setup, optionally adds the gstack section to CLAUDE.md, and offers team mode. Updates in place if gstack is already present.
